csv_project_name: Consultant for DECC Complex Facilities Condition Assessment
csv_scope_of_work: The Duluth Entertainment Convention Center (DECC), a Minnesota State Authority, invites proposals from qualified firms to perform a comprehensive Facilities Condition Assessment (FCA) of the DECC complex. The FCA will inventory major building systems, evaluate current condition, estimate remaining useful life, identify deficiencies and deferred maintenance, and develop a capital renewal plan to guide investment over a 10 20 year horizon. This engagement is a professional/technical services contract and will be procured via competitive proposals consistent with Minnesota state procurement requirements and the DECC s Procurement and Purchasing Policy.
